approved_translation: Unity is strength; quarrels among yourselves make you vulnerable to those who would exploit you.
translation_author: Ellen C. Babbitt (retold from traditional sources)
context_summary: Once upon a time many quails lived together in a forest. The wisest of them all was their leader. So the quails quarreled, and while they were quarreling the fowler caught them all in his net. He took them to town and sold them for a good price.
